events.void-click: Fires after an enabled button is activated, once any form submit or reset it does has run. Not fired while the button is disabled. A native `click` listener works too.

void-button.children: The label: text, or text with an icon. For an icon-only button put an `aria-label` on the button. A link can go inside to make a link that looks like a button.

events.void-input: Fires on every edit of the text. `detail.value` is the new text.
events.void-change: Fires when the text is committed (the field loses focus after a change). `detail.value` is the text.
events.void-action: Fires when the action button is pressed. `detail.value` is the current text.

events.void-change: Fires when the user toggles the checkbox. `detail.checked` is the new state.
Fires when a checkbox in the group is toggled. `detail.values` lists the values of the checked boxes.

void-checkbox-group.children: Takes `void-checkbox` children. The `label` attribute names the group.

events.void-change: Fires when the colour changes by dragging, typing a hex value or choosing a swatch; `detail.value` is the hex string. It fires continuously while dragging.

events.void-input: Fires on every edit of the text. `detail.value` is the new text.
events.void-submit: Fires when the user presses the send button or the send key. `detail.value` is the message; the field is cleared afterwards. Not fired when the field is empty or disabled.

events.void-change: Fires when the user picks a day. `detail.value` is the ISO date and `detail.date` the same day as a `Date`.
Fires when the user picks a day. `detail.value` is the ISO date and `detail.date` the same day as a `Date`.
Fires when the user commits an edit (Enter or leaving the field). `detail.value` is the new text.
events.void-cancel: Fires when the user abandons an edit with Escape; the previous value stays.

void-field.children: Exactly one control: a `void-input`, `void-select`, `void-textarea` or another form control. The `label`, `helper` and `error` attributes supply the text around it.

events.void-change: Fires when the chosen files change, by dropping, browsing or removing one. `detail.files` is the list of accepted `File`s.

events.void-input: Fires on every keystroke. `detail.value` is the new text.
events.void-change: Fires when the value is committed (the field loses focus after a change). `detail.value` is the text.
Fires when an option is selected or deselected. `detail.values` lists every selected value.

void-multiselect.children: Takes `void-option` children, one per choice. Mark the initial ones with `selected`.

events.void-change: Fires when the value changes by typing, the step buttons or the arrow keys. `detail.value` is the new number and `detail.previous` the old one.
Fires on every edit of the code. `detail.value` is the characters entered so far.
events.void-complete: Fires once every cell is filled. `detail.value` is the full code.

events.void-change: Fires when the user chooses this radio. `detail.value` is its value and `detail.checked` is true.
Fires when the user chooses a radio. `detail.value` is its value.

void-radio-group.children: Takes `void-radio` children. The `label` attribute names the group.

events.void-change: Fires when the user chooses a segment. `detail.value` is its value.

void-segmented-control-item.children: The label text of one segment.

events.void-change: Fires when the user chooses an option. `detail.value` is its value.

events.void-input: Fires continuously while the thumb moves. `detail.value` is the current number.
events.void-change: Fires when the user releases the thumb or uses the keyboard. `detail.value` is the number.
Fires when the user flips the switch. `detail.checked` is the new state.
Fires when a tag is added or removed. `detail.value` is the full list of tags.

events.void-change: Fires when the value is committed (the field loses focus after a change). `detail.value` is the text.
Fires when the user presses the toggle. `detail.pressed` is the new state.

void-toggle.children: The label text or an icon (give an icon-only toggle an `aria-label`).

events.void-change: Fires when the user presses a toggle. `detail.value` is an array of pressed values with `multiple`, otherwise the pressed value or an empty string.

void-dialog.children: The dialog body: text, forms and buttons. The `heading` attribute is the title and the dialog's accessible name.

events.void-close: Fires when the drawer closes itself (the close button, Escape or a backdrop click).

void-drawer.children: The drawer body: any content. The `heading` attribute is the title and the drawer's accessible name.

void-dropdown-menu.children: One element marked `slot="trigger"` that opens the menu, then `void-dropdown-menu-item` children for the actions.

events.void-select: Fires when the item is activated. `detail.item` is the item element; read its text or attributes to tell items apart.

events.void-open: Fires when the card opens, on hover or focus of the trigger.

void-hover-card.children: One element marked `slot="trigger"`, then the card content.

void-menu-group.children: Takes `void-menu-item` children. The `label` attribute is the group heading.

events.void-select: Fires when the item is activated. `detail.value` is its `value`.

events.void-close: Fires when the popover closes itself (Escape or a click outside).

void-popover.children: One element marked `slot="trigger"`, then the popover content.

void-tooltip.children: The one element the tooltip describes. The tip text is the `text` attribute.

void-breadcrumbs.children: A list of links in order, with the current page as the last item (a `span` or a link with `aria-current`).

events.void-toggle: Fires when the user presses the button. `detail.active` is the new state.

void-nav-bar.children: A brand, a set of links and controls, laid out in a row: `void-brand`, `void-nav-links`, `void-spacer` and buttons, as in the example.

events.void-open: Fires when the item opens its panel.
events.void-close: Fires when the item closes its panel.

void-nav-menu-item.children: The label text, then (to open a panel) the panel content, such as a list of links. With `href` it is a plain link and takes no panel.

events.void-change: Fires when the user picks a page. `detail.value` is the page number.

events.void-toggle: Fires when the sidebar collapses or expands. `detail.collapsed` is the new state.

void-sidebar.children: The navigation content: links, `void-nav-links` or any markup.

events.void-change: Fires when the user selects a tab. `detail.value` is the `tab` of the panel now shown.

void-tab-panel.children: The content of one tab. The `label` attribute is the tab's text and `tab` its identifier.

void-badge.children: Short text, a count or a status word.

events.void-change: Fires when the visible slide changes. `detail.index` is the new slide and `detail.previous` the one before.

void-carousel-slide.children: The content of one slide: text, an image, any markup.

events.void-click: Fires when an `interactive` item is activated.

events.void-remove: Fires when the user presses the remove button of a `removable` tag, just before the tag removes itself from the page.

events.void-dismiss: Fires when the user presses the dismiss button of a `dismissible` alert, just before the alert removes itself from the page.

void-alert.children: The message text and any inline markup, such as a link.

events.void-close: Fires when the user presses the close button of a `dismissable` banner, just before the banner removes itself from the page.

void-banner.children: The message text and any inline markup, such as a link.

events.void-retry: Fires when the user presses the retry button of a `retryable` fallback.

void-accordion.children: Takes `void-accordion-item` children. Without `multiple`, opening one item closes the others.

events.void-toggle: Fires after the item opens or closes. `detail.open` is the new state.

void-accordion-item.children: Its `heading` attribute is the title shown on the button; the children are the body that opens and closes.

void-card.children: The card body: any content. The title comes from the `heading` attribute.

events.void-toggle: Fires after the section opens or closes. `detail.open` is the new state.

void-collapsible.children: The body that opens and closes. The `heading` attribute is the title shown on the button.

void-panel.children: The panel body: any content. The `label` attribute is the heading and the region's accessible name.

void-scroll-area.children: Any content taller or wider than the area; it scrolls inside.
